title: Accend Raises $3.2M to Reinvent Fintech Operations and Compliance Workflows
summary: Accend, an AI-driven startup aiming to revolutionize the onboarding process for fintechs and banks, has successfully secured $3.2M in seed funding. The round, led by Adverb Ventures with participation from Y Combinator, General Catalyst, and others, supports Accend’s mission to disrupt traditional business process outsourcing providers like Accenture by enhancing the efficiency and quality of compliance and risk operations. With significant traction in both the US and European markets and endorsements from top fintech companies, Accend is poised to accelerate its product offerings, including an expansion into automated underwriting processes.
